scripts.build:wavedash: vite build --mode wavedash --base=./ --outDir=wavedash-dist && wavedash build push
scripts.build:itch: vite build --mode itch --base=./ && cd dist && tar -a -cf ../chaos-arena-itch.zip * && cd .. && move chaos-arena-itch.zip dist\
scripts.build:glitch: vite build --mode glitch --base=./ && cd dist && tar -a -cf ../chaos-arena-glitch.zip * && cd .. && move chaos-arena-glitch.zip dist\
scripts.build:game-distribution: vite build --mode game-distribution --base=./ && cd dist && tar -a -cf ../chaos-arena-gd.zip * && cd .. && move chaos-arena-gd.zip dist\
scripts.build:y8: vite build --mode y8 --base=./ && cd dist && tar -a -cf ../chaos-arena-y8.zip * && cd .. && move chaos-arena-y8.zip dist\
scripts.build:gamepix: vite build --mode gamepix --base=./ && cd dist && tar -a -cf ../chaos-arena-gamepix.zip * && cd .. && move chaos-arena-gamepix.zip dist\
scripts.build:playgama: vite build --mode playgama --base=./ && cd dist && tar -a -cf ../chaos-arena-playgama.zip * && cd .. && move chaos-arena-playgama.zip dist\
scripts.build:youtube: vite build --mode youtube --base=./ && cd dist && tar -a -cf ../chaos-arena-youtube.zip * && cd .. && move chaos-arena-youtube.zip dist\
scripts.deploy-demo: vite build --mode demo && surge dist/ --domain chaos-arena-demo.surge.sh
scripts.tauri:build-android-apk: dotenv -e .env.tauri -e .env.tauri.remote -- tauri android build --apk && node scripts/bump-android-version-code.mjs
scripts.tauri:build-android-aab: dotenv -e .env.tauri -e .env.tauri.remote -- tauri android build --aab && node scripts/bump-android-version-code.mjs
scripts.ci:android:aab: gh workflow run android-build.yml -f format=aab -f build_type=release && echo "Triggered AAB release build — track at: $(gh repo view --json url -q .url)/actions/workflows/android-build.yml"
scripts.ci:android:apk: gh workflow run android-build.yml -f format=apk -f build_type=release && echo "Triggered APK release build — track at: $(gh repo view --json url -q .url)/actions/workflows/android-build.yml"
scripts.ci:ios:testflight: gh workflow run ios-build.yml -f export_method=app-store-connect -f upload_testflight=true && echo "Triggered iOS TestFlight build — track at: $(gh repo view --json url -q .url)/actions/workflows/ios-build.yml"
scripts.native-package:demo: dotenv -e .env.nativedemo -- pnpm run native-build && electron-builder --config.productName="Chaos Arena Demo" --config.nsis.shortcutName="Chaos Arena Demo" --config.directories.output="electron/dist-demo" --config.win.artifactName="${productName}-Setup-${version}.${ext}"
